ingredientSections.heading: Shrimps
items: 20 large Shrimp, with shells and heads
½ Cup Fava Beans, blanched and peeled (see below)
6-8 strips Streaky Bacon, fried to crispy
2 sprigs Chervil, picked into garnish sized pieces

ingredientSections.heading: Grits
items: 1 Cup Dried Hominy Grits, or White Corn Grits if you can’t find Hominy

ingredientSections.heading: Sauce
items: 2 L Dark Chicken Stock (made from roasted chicken bones)
All the heads and shells from the shrimp

methodSections.heading: Grits
steps: In large pot cook the grits in the water for an hour or until soft. You may need to blend the grits with a hand blender depending on the type of grits you have. The grits should be the consistency of thick porridge.
Add the salt, butter and cheese and set aside, keeping hot.

methodSections.heading: Oven Dried Tomatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 80°C (175°F). Slice tomatoes in half and place cut side up on a baking sheet or tray. Season with salt and drizzle with oil.
Place in the oven for about 2 hours.

methodSections.heading: Sauce
steps: Remove the heads and shells from the shrimp and set aside the meat, covered, in the fridge.

Place a large saucepan on a burner on a high heat. Add one tablespoon of butter to the pan. When the butter foams, add the shrimp heads and shells and stir for 5-7 minutes until they have all changed colour and there is a strong aroma of roasted shrimp.
Add the chicken stock, bring to a boil and reduce down to half a litre.
Strain the stock using a fine strainer and discard the shells.

In a medium pot add four tablespoons of butter and heat to a foam. Add the garlic, shallots, chilli flakes and rosemary. Sweat for 1 minute and add the stock. Reduce to around one cup, add three tablespoons of lemon juice and pulse it with a hand blender until it is smooth.

methodSections.heading: Fava Beans
steps: Shuck the beans from their pods and boil in heavily salted water for about 2 minutes. Strain and place straight into ice water.
Remove the bright green beans from the tough outer skin and set aside.

methodSections.heading: Finish and Serve
steps: In a large fry pan cook the bacon until crispy. Drain on paper towel and break into halves or thirds.
Wipe out the same fry pan and bring back to a high heat, add the sauce which should have reduced enough to be thick and a little sticky and bring to a simmer.
Add the peeled shrimp and cook for about a minute on each side, add the tomatoes and fava beans and cook one more minute. Finish with lemon and salt to taste.
Divide the grits into four bowls and then distribute the shrimp, tomatoes, fava beans and sauce evenly. Garnish with crispy bacon and picked chervil.
